subject: Post-demo recap — Novum Health: decision criteria, procurement path, and champion enablement
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
To: Lydia Park <lydia.park@novumhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Dec 2026 14:02:00 -0500
Subject: Post-demo recap — Novum Health: decision criteria, procurement path, and champion enablement

Hi Lydia —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned internally and for your procurement/legal loop: 

Summary of discovery:
- Primary outcomes: reduce query turnaround for clinical search use cases; improve embedding retrieval relevance for care teams.
- Top decision criteria you shared: 1) <10% regression vs current recall on key benchmarks, 2) data residency and audit logs, 3) predictable cost per 1k requests.
- Economic buyer: Sanjay Rao (CFO) — you mentioned budget decision expected in the next 6–8 weeks.

Procurement & security path you described:
- Security questionnaire step (SaaS vendor assessment) — Nov 3rd: you will circulate initial questionnaire to vendors (you expect answers within 7 business days).
- Legal review + PII addendum (if required) — involves Novum legal + procurement.

Action items I'm proposing:
1) I attached a mutual_action_plan.xlsx (stub) that maps milestones to owners — can you confirm owners/timing?
2) Please introduce me to procurement@novumhealth.com and to Sanjay (or let me share a short CFO one-pager first).
3) I’ll loop in Marissa (solutions) and Ben (SE) to prepare a short CFO-friendly ROI one-pager and the security checklist answers.

Risks we flagged: model governance/retention policies and audit logs — happy to provide our SOC2 scope and a short note on data handling.

Next proposed meeting: procurement + security intake call — are you available week of Dec 14 for a 30-min sync?

Thanks — appreciate your help getting the right folks involved.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
rafael@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0172

Attachments:
- mutual_action_plan.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: Lydia Park <lydia.park@novumhealth.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@novumhealth.com
Date: Sat, 11 Dec 2026 09:18:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap — Novum Health: decision criteria, procurement path, and champion enablement

Rafael —

Thanks for the clear recap and for taking notes. A few items from my side: 

- Confirmed owners/timing: procurement@novumhealth.com will own the questionnaire (I expect them to send the intake to vendors on Monday, Dec 14). Sanjay Rao (CFO) will land the budget decision after legal signs off — likely late Jan if timelines hold.
- Please do send the CFO one-pager first — Sanjay prefers concise, dollarized impact or a clear cost comparison.
- Procurement will want to see: SOC2 or equivalent, data retention policy, and an initial answers packet for the vendor security questionnaire. They often do a 2-pass review (technical then legal).

I'm attaching our internal procurement intake guidance (redacted) — high level items they look at. I also flagged that we need a clear list of what data leaves our VPC vs what stays on-prem.

Happy to run a short intro to Sanjay if you share the one-pager beforehand. Week of Dec 14 for a procurement intake call works for me.

Cheers,
Lydia Park
Senior Product Manager, Clinical Search | Novum Health
lydia.park@novumhealth.com

Date: Sat, 11 Dec 2026 09:45:00 -0500
Subject: Fwd: Post-demo recap — Novum Health — needs: CFO one-pager + security packet (RDW-4391)

Marissa / Ben —

Forwarding Lydia's reply from Novum (attached above). Quick asks so we can move quickly once procurement opens the intake on Dec 14: 

1) Marissa — can you draft a 1-page CFO brief (impact + cost comparison + suggested pilot pricing) by EOD Dec 12 so I can share with Lydia for the intro to Sanjay? Keep it dollarized and include a short operational benefit statement.
2) Ben — can you put together initial answers for the typical security questionnaire items: SOC2 link, data residency, retention, audit logs, and a short paragraph on KV cache handling for PII? A checklist doc is fine.
3) Also need a short slide (1–2) mapping our deployment options: Hosted API vs Dedicated vs Private (one line risk/cost tradeoffs) so procurement can evaluate fast.

I'll take the mutual_action_plan worksheet and update ownership once I have the docs from you both. Goal: be ready to answer intake within 48 hours of procurement outreach.

Thanks — Rafael

Rafael / Ben —

Thanks — I put together the requested artifacts and attached them below:

- CFO-one-pager.pdf (one-page ROI + payback with conservative/likely/optimistic scenarios)
- security-eval-checklist.docx (answers to common vendor questionnaire items; SOC2 link included)
- pricing-summary.pdf (pilot and 12-month committed tiers)

Highlights to call out for the CFO brief:
- 6–9 month payback in the conservative scenario assuming 15% improvement in clinical retrieval time and 20% clinician time savings on backlog tasks.
- Upside case includes lifecycle cost reductions if we enable autoscaling and prefix caching.

Next steps I propose:
- Rafael to share CFO-one-pager with Lydia prior to intro to Sanjay (I recommend an email summary + the PDF).
- Schedule 30-min procurement intake (Procurement + Security + Rafael + Ben + Marissa). Lydia said week of Dec 14 — I'll propose Tue Dec 15 10:00 AM ET and Tue Dec 15 3:00 PM ET as options.
- Ben/Marissa to respond to procurement questionnaire within 48 business hours of receipt.

Let me know if you want tweaks to the CFO framing — I kept the technical detail to one paragraph and focused on dollars.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Head of Solutions | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123
